title: Move over Solo cups!
text: Move over Solo cups!. Great cups! Perfect size, love the color! These fit ergonomically in your hands with the Easy Grip technology, allows for no-slippage when you are 'partying hearty', lol. I actual prefer these now to the Solo cups I had been using. My new favorite drink cup for sure!!!!
